title: AMD annual net revenue
definition: Total annual consolidated net revenue reported by Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. in its Form 10-K filings (fiscal year ends on the last Saturday of December).

sources.title: Form 10-K for the Fiscal Year Ended December 27, 2025

points.evidence: Item 8, Consolidated Statements of Operations (in millions): Total net revenue for fiscal year ended December 28, 2024 was 25,785.
Item 8, Consolidated Statements of Operations (in millions): Total net revenue for fiscal year ended December 27, 2025 was 34,639.
